name: VWI Advanced Revisions Manager
author: vasanikevin2016

sections.description:
VWI Advanced Revisions Manager helps you optimize your WordPress website by managing post revisions efficiently and preventing database bloat.

By default, WordPress stores unlimited revisions. This plugin gives you granular control to set global limits, configure specific post types (like posts, pages, or custom types), or let empty fields inherit the global rule automatically.

Key Features:

  • Global Limit: Set a default fallback limit for all post types.
  • Granular Control & Inheritance: Define custom limits per post type, or leave fields blank to seamlessly inherit the global setting.
  • One-Click Database Cleanup: Delete all existing old revisions and orphaned postmeta instantly to free up database space.
  • Lightweight & Secure: Built using native WordPress APIs with full sanitization and security checks.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the vwi-advanced-revisions-manager folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the zip package via the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > VWI Revisions to manage your revision limits.
sections.faq:
What happens if I leave post-type limit fields blank?

If a specific post-type field is left blank, it automatically inherits whatever limit you have set in the Global Revisions Limit.
